subject.title: Cron running_at_ms not cleared after agentTurn run

question: Should maintainers treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/81572 as the fix path for this latest-release recurring `agentTurn` running-marker report, or require a narrower live repro first?
rationale: Current source shows a credible stale-marker class and the issue has concrete release steps, but the exact single-job report is not isolated and an overlapping proven PR is already open.

options.title: Review or adapt the existing PR
options.body: Use the open incremental-finalization PR as the primary path, rebasing it through current main and adding coverage for this issue's recurring isolated agentTurn case.

options.title: Require a live single-job repro first
options.body: Keep this issue open with no code change until a maintainer or contributor reproduces the exact v2026.6.11 single-job SQLite state transition.

options.title: Queue a replacement only if needed
options.body: Open a new repair path only if the existing PR is rejected or cannot be safely rebased without losing current scheduler safeguards.

recommendation.title: Review or adapt the existing PR
recommendation.body: Use the open incremental-finalization PR as the primary path, rebasing it through current main and adding coverage for this issue's recurring isolated agentTurn case.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent cron task-state work and broad area history make this the best available routing candidate for deciding proof sufficiency and fix direction.
